items.note: Merz arrived by special train. A drone then hit the Northern Bridge roadway over the Dnipro.
Kim oversaw a Saturday IRBM from Wonsan. KCNA claimed 1,000 km; Seoul had more than 700 km.
Two million barrels of Iraqi crude said to have gone beyond the strait on a VLCC.
City election commission reported 30 polling stations still closed after the morning open.
Debris from the aircraft lies south of here. Overnight the search was still for the people aboard.

rest.what: The Coast Guard confirmed Gulfstream debris south of Nantucket after covering 1,644 square miles and said the search for the six aboard continues. Next check 17:00 UTC.

lead.what: The Central Election Commission opened Sunday's general election for 3,414,364 eligible voters. Bijeljina reported 30 stations still closed after the morning open. Next check 17:00 UTC.

rest.what: Three of Kyiv's six road bridges over the Dnipro were already restricted this week when a drone hit the Northern Bridge roadway Sunday morning.

lead.what: Kim Jong Un oversaw Saturday's intermediate-range launch, state media said, claiming a 1,000 km hit. Seoul timed more than 700 km from the Wonsan area.

rest.what: Iraq's Oil Tankers Company said a VLCC carried two million barrels of Iraqi crude beyond the Strait of Hormuz, its first such operation in decades.
